$description: BIM FLOOR PLATE ASSEMBLY RULES token category — machine-readable validation rules for a valid floor plate composition. Previously all rules were narrative-only in PDFs; tool-floorplates cannot validate a composition without a machine-readable form of these rules. Source: tool-buildingwidth-architecture.md §Missing DTCG token files #2 (2026-05-17, Opus agent research), synthesising AEC_Floor Plates_Key Plans and Tiles_V12.pdf and AEC_Floor Plates_Methodology_V12.pdf. Created 2026-07-03 — this file did not previously exist. Rule IDs (FP-*) match the identifiers already referenced elsewhere in this token set (e.g. tile-system.dtcg.json's corridor-expander notes cite 'Decision 4' and Tile/Key-Plan/Floor-Plate negotiation, which these rules formalise).

fp-sum-001.$description: FP-SUM-001 — the sum of all tiles, special tiles, core area, and amenities must equal the target net leasable area within ±100 SF.

$value.predicate: end_cap_tiles placed at short_sides only AND natural_light on both perpendicular_axes

fp-endcap-001.$description: FP-ENDCAP-001 — end-cap tiles (B-1, E-1, E-2, and the Medium-family end caps) may only be placed at the building's short sides, and must have natural light on both perpendicular axes at that position.

fp-core-001.$description: FP-CORE-001 — the building core must be an Offset Pulled Back Core, positioned at least 18m from the short end of the building.

fp-snap-001.$description: FP-SNAP-001 — a special tile's width should snap to the nearest Private Office key-plan width, within a ±50 SF tolerance.

fp-climate-001.$description: FP-CLIMATE-001 — each tile is exactly one HVAC climate zone (see bim.tile.design-principles.climate-zone-autonomy in tile-system.dtcg.json — this rule formalises that design principle as a validation predicate).

fp-doors-001.$description: FP-DOORS-001 — a maximum of 10 doors per tile and 80 doors per floor.

fp-corner-001.$description: FP-CORNER-001 — a Small-family tile placed at a building corner triggers a required structural-grid review (see tile-system.dtcg.json's corner-handling design principle and the Tile E-1/E-2 'review structural grid before specifying' notes — this rule formalises that caution as a validation predicate).
